title: Structured desktop MCP exposure
objective: Make structured desktop observation live on real Windows and expose it as bounded read-only MCP tools: visible top-level windows and their processes in the caller's interactive session, and a bounded UI Automation element tree for one bound window, through the closed SG-000027 registry with its identity, protected-surface exclusion, redaction, and bounds; qualify UIA actuation, screenshots, visual proposals, and coordinate fallback against the live native adapter and expose none that is not live, keeping human interruption and input leases authoritative.

include: native window enumeration of visible top-level windows and owning processes in the same session through Win32, with process identity from the image path and start time
native bounded UI Automation tree reads for one window through the control view with password values redacted
read-only MCP tools for window listing and window tree observation through the existing registry and its protected-surface exclusion
a per-shape qualification of actuation, screenshot, visual proposal, coordinate, and input shapes against the live native adapter with test-pinned decisions
real Windows evidence on a window the test creates, and fail-closed behavior where no interactive desktop exists
exclude: any actuation, screenshot, coordinate, or synthetic input shape that the live native adapter does not implement
raw SendInput, keyboard or mouse injection, window focus stealing, or process termination

authority_delta.process: Read-only process facts for processes that own visible windows in the caller's session.
authority_delta.secrets: Password fields are redacted; protected surfaces are excluded.

invariants: observation never actuates, focuses, or injects input
protected surfaces and other sessions are never observed
no MCP tool claims desktop capability the native adapter does not implement

acceptance.claim: Window listing and bounded tree observation are live on real Windows, bounded, redacted, and exclude protected surfaces and other sessions.
Every non-live desktop shape is recorded and pinned off the MCP surface, and observation fails closed without an interactive desktop.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000064: Clipboard and bounded network exposure may proceed only after SG-000063 closes.

done_when: Live read-only desktop observation is canonical and exposed, and every non-live desktop shape is recorded and hidden.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: genuine TypeSafe Jev exact-diff review covered 43/43 hunks with zero findings and zero blocking findings, pin 31f89602797fb7bea007f8a480bf368bf564954e
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Alibaba Open Code Review v1.12.9 exact-range delegation over 21 changed files, 13 reviewable with delegated rules applied and 8 excluded (apps/cotra-mcp/src/oauth-authorization.test.ts, parity-inventory.test.ts, surface.test.ts, transport-contract.test.ts, and uia.test.ts by default-path classification and docs/p16/CAPABILITY_PARITY.md, docs/p16/DESKTOP_QUALIFICATION.md, and docs/security/SG-000063_DESKTOP_OBSERVATION_NOTE.md by unsupported-extension classification) manually reviewed
canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head: live read-only desktop observation through Win32 and UI Automation limited to the interactive window station, the caller's session, visible uncloaked titled top-level windows of other processes, with process identity from the image path and creation time; no input, window messages, pattern invocation, focus, activation, or capture; the observing process, Cotra executables, and the Windows credential, consent, and logon prompt hosts excluded; protected Cotra markers omitted and counted; password values never read; handle reuse re-verified before every tree read; bounded depth, nodes, strings, response bytes, and UIA timeouts; every actuation, screenshot, visual, coordinate, and input shape qualified not live, failing closed, recorded intentionally denied, and pinned off the MCP surface; both tools local-only and denied on every remote path. Real Windows evidence on a probe window and end to end through the MCP stdio server and cotrad. All closed SG-000001 through SG-000062 regressions pass. CodeRabbit skipped-review and cubic skipping notices evaluated as non-evidence noise with zero substantive findings; zero unresolved threads.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Read-only desktop observation in the caller's interactive session through two local-only MCP tools (desktop_window_list, desktop_window_tree) over the closed SG-000027 shapes. No actuation, capture, input, focus, termination, browser, clipboard, network, or remote desktop authority.
